scope_note: Activities curated within <=1 hour travel from a Center-Strip hotel (LINQ / Flamingo / Horseshoe / Paris / Caesars Palace). Transit accessibility is explicitly distinguished from car/rideshare/tour-only outdoor parks.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.travel_from_center_strip: Walk (5–10 min from LINQ/Flamingo/Paris/Caesars) or RTC Deuce
activities.hours: Mon–Fri: every 30 min 3:00–7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM–12:00 AM; Sat–Sun & Holidays: every 30 min 12:00–7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM–12:00 AM
activities.exceptions: Outdoor show subject to wind/weather cancellation; Mon Feb 15, 2027 (Washington's Birthday) follows Holiday schedule starting 12:00 PM.

activities.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
activities.travel_from_center_strip: Walk (5–10 min from LINQ/Flamingo/Paris/Caesars) or RTC Deuce
activities.hours: Open during seasonal installation runs (see 2027 schedule below)
activities.exceptions: CRITICAL 2027 DATES: Lunar New Year display runs Jan 9 – Mar 6, 2027; DARK DATES (CLOSED for changeover) Mar 7 – Mar 12, 2027; Spring display opens Mar 13 – May 15, 2027. Feb 15–22 visits catch the Lunar New Year display.
flags: If shifting trip into Mar 7–12, 2027, the Conservatory is CLOSED (dark dates).

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel (The LINQ)

activities.hours: Daily from 12:00 PM / 12:30 PM to Close (verify closing hour on ride date)

activities.name: The Mob Museum & The Underground Speakeasy

activities.cost_for_2_adults: $75.90 General Admission ($37.95×2); $99.90 Deluxe ($49.95×2); $109.90 Premier ($54.95×2, or $95.90 online Morning/Evening discount)

activities.name: The Neon Museum (Neon Boneyard)
activities.travel_from_center_strip: RTC Deuce northbound to Downtown + ~15-min walk or short rideshare (~30–40 min total)
activities.cost_for_2_adults: From $42.00 (2027 Admission starts at $21/adult × 2, plus ticket processing fee)
activities.hours: Sept–May: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM daily (Last Admission 10:00 PM; Box Office closes 1 hr before close)
activities.exceptions: NEW 2027 POLICY: Starting Jan 1, 2027, single '2027 Admission' replaces separate daytime/evening tiers, AND arriving earlier/later than your selected ticket time may incur a higher price. Outdoor collection subject to lightning/wind/heat closure; phones/tablets only (no DSLR/tripods/selfie sticks). Phone: 702-387-6366.

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
activities.travel_from_center_strip: ~30 min drive west (17 miles on SR 159) — NO public transit
activities.cost_for_2_adults: $22.00 per personal vehicle ($20.00 1-day vehicle fee + $2.00 nonrefundable Recreation.gov timed-entry fee; covers both adults)
activities.hours: Scenic Drive: Nov–Feb 6:00 AM–5:00 PM PST; March 6:00 AM–7:00 PM PST. Visitor Center: Daily 8:00 AM–4:30 PM
activities.exceptions: MANDATORY TIMED ENTRY: Required Oct 1 – May 31 for entry 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (book at Recreation.gov 30 days ahead at 7:00 AM PT, or 2 days ahead at 7:00 AM PT). NO public transportation; rideshare users limited to Visitor Center area; download/print ticket before arrival (weak cell signal); flush toilets/water at Visitor Center only.
flags: BLM FAQ PDF still states older $15 fee while live Recreation.gov checkout charges $20.00 + $2.00 = $22.00 — flagged.
Not reachable by public bus/monorail; requires rental car or commercial tour.

activities.name: Hoover Dam & Powerplant Tours
activities.travel_from_center_strip: ~45–50 min drive southeast (~35 miles via I-11) — NO public transit
activities.cost_for_2_adults: $30.00 Self-Guided ($15×2); $50.00 Powerplant Tour ($25×2); $80.00 Guided Dam Tour ($40×2, on-site only) + $10 garage parking
activities.days_open: Daily (Closed Thanksgiving & Christmas Day for Visitor Center/Tours)
activities.hours: Dam top: 5:00 AM–9:00 PM PST; Visitor Center & Tours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM (doors close 4:15 PM; last tour 4:10 PM)
activities.exceptions: Interagency National Parks passes NOT accepted; Guided Dam Tour ($40/pp) sold IN PERSON ONLY (entire party must be present, routinely sells out early); vehicle inspection + airport-style security screening; no drones/weapons/pocketknives; no strollers or motorized scooters on Dam Tour.
flags: Not reachable by public transit; requires rental car or commercial tour.

activities.name: Valley of Fire State Park (Boundary ~50–60 Min Drive)
activities.category: Outdoor Desert Park (Car Required — 1-Hr Limit Boundary)
activities.travel_from_center_strip: ~50–60 min drive northeast via I-15 (~50 miles) — NO public transit; DO NOT use Uber/Lyft
activities.cost_for_2_adults: $15.00 per non-Nevada vehicle ($10.00 Nevada vehicle; covers both adults)
activities.hours: Park: Sunrise to Sunset daily; Visitor Center: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM daily
activities.exceptions: Feb–Mar is prime season: ALL major trails (Fire Wave, White Domes, Pastel Canyon) are OPEN (closed May 15–Sep 30 for heat). Day-use reservations NOT required. OFFICIAL WARNING: Do NOT take Uber/Lyft — return rides are often unavailable and visitors can be stranded. Travel time sits right at the ~60-minute boundary depending on I-15 traffic.
flags: Drive time (~50–60 min each way from Strip) sits at the <=1 hour boundary and may exceed 60 min in traffic — flagged for review.
Not reachable by public transit; official Nevada State Parks page warns against Uber/Lyft.
